title: Minimax Precision for Front-Door Policy Means with Rare Mediator Values
banked_reason: The elementary Θ(1) collapse is below the field floor: no comparison establishes why allowing arbitrarily near-zero common-cell mass is a field advance. Independent validity gate confirms terminal; the causal-membership trial bridge remains incomplete.
gap_reasons: The elementary Θ(1) collapse is below the field floor: related work omits the closer irregular-weighting antecedent Khan--Tamer (2010), and no comparison establishes why this direct consequence of allowing arbitrarily near-zero common-cell mass is a field advance.

The sentence about an intervention trial with A_M randomized independently of V is neither defined nor compatible with the displayed completion A_M=A=1{V_2≤1/2}; state a separate trial law and bridge, or delete it from this membership lemma.
proof_attempt_summary: The proposed all-regime nonconstant learned-mediator frontier collapsed because the literal class allows common-cell information to vanish on a fixed interval. One bounded root retry produced elementary matched constant-order risk and honest-length calculations, including public q, but the reviewer rejected their novelty below the field floor and flagged an incomplete intervention-trial causal-membership bridge. Independent validity consultation confirmed termination; no D0 solution or Lean formalization was produced, and both the causal bridge and exact decision constants remain unresolved.
tldr: The full intervening-variable policy mean is point identified, while minimax mean squared error, root risk, and maximal expected length of uniformly 90\%-honest connected intervals have order \(\Theta(1)\) over the literal submitted class for every fixed \(\beta,\eta\in(0,1]\) and \(\kappa>1\). The conclusion holds both when \(q\) is learned and when its entire true function is supplied. Explicit alternatives share \(q_\varepsilon(x)=(1-\varepsilon)/\max\{x,1/2\}^{\kappa}\), have a fixed policy-mean gap, and make the common mediator cell arbitrarily uninformative on a fixed interval at \(\varepsilon=\varepsilon_n\asymp n^{-2}\). Bounded-range procedures attain the constant orders without either nuisance. Learning \(q\) has no rate-level price. Exact decision constants remain an open question on the same class. A nontrivial smoothness phase frontier requires an additional quantitative common-cell or overlap envelope; none is proposed or encoded here.
gap: Wen--Sarvet--Stensrud identify the intervention mean under qualitative positivity. Qualitative positivity and H\"older regularity alone do not provide a uniform precision guarantee for this full policy mean. The joint-complexity question in Mou--Ding--Wainwright--Bartlett, Section 6, concerns structural restrictions that must be specified quantitatively before a shrinking frontier can be assigned.
fill: Same-class full-likelihood testing and direct coverage transfer yield matched constant-order lower bounds for every procedure. A constant estimator and the deterministic covering interval provide observable upper bounds. The remaining decision question asks whether public knowledge changes optimal constants on this same class.
